name: @w6w-apps/outlook
description: Read, send, and organize Microsoft Outlook mail and calendar events via the Microsoft Graph API.

w6w.longDescription:
This app manages Microsoft Outlook mail and calendar through the Microsoft Graph API: sending, drafting, replying to, forwarding, and organizing messages, and creating, updating, and reading calendar events, including the expanded occurrences of a recurring meeting rather than just its series definition. It covers the two surfaces a user actually means by "Outlook", deliberately leaving out the much larger Microsoft 365 surface Graph also exposes — contacts, Teams, OneDrive, and directory administration are each their own product with their own consent scopes.

A few details matter for reliability: only event creation is safe to retry automatically, since Graph offers no dedupe key for sending or drafting a message, so those are treated as one-shot actions. Deleting a meeting you organize notifies every attendee, with no way to suppress it, and paging through a large mailbox or calendar follows Graph's own continuation links rather than reconstructing them, bounded so an unbounded inbox cannot turn into an unbounded run.
